connect.title: Your personal email assistant
connect.lead: Noah reads new emails in your inbox, sorts them and writes reply drafts in your style.
connect.point1: Drafts go to Outlook Drafts, in the right thread. Nothing is ever sent automatically.
connect.point2: Newsletters and automatic notifications are filtered out, important mail comes first.
connect.point3: Every 15 minutes, even when Orbit is closed. Pause or disconnect any time.
